text:
maria: Heads-up — we're adding per-route SLO dashboards that show latency P50/P95/P99, TTFT, and tokens/sec (both emitted and effective after caching). Need alignment on metric names, labels, and acceptable downsampling for 30d/90d retention. Who can give runtime/ingest constraints?

kevin: Runtime side here. We already emit a latency histogram and counters for tokens. Suggested names: `route_latency_ms_bucket` (histogram), `route_latency_ms_sum`, `route_latency_ms_count`, and `tokens_emitted_total{route,model,deployment}`. For TTFT we can expose `route_ttft_ms` as a summary. Downsampling: prefer 1m rate rollups, 5m for long term.

ajay: From platform/ingest: we need stable labels: `route`, `model`, `variant`, `region`. Avoid high-cardinality labels like `request_id` or `user_id`. Also please include `deployment_id` so console can pin to a rollout.

sam: Console UX asks for a few pre-baked panels: top 10 routes by P95 latency, TTFT heatmap by route, tokens/sec timeseries + a derived gauge for effective tokens/sec (post-cache). Also we want an annotation for `last_deploy_ts` and a toggle to switch model vs route view.

nina: SRE note: cardinality is the big risk. We can accept `model` and `variant` but please cap unique `route` values (no per-customer routing labels). Also sample traces for slow TTFT only. If we can't avoid cardinality we should use a mapping service that emits route -> route_group.

kevin: Agreed on labels. Implementation plan: emit histograms with 1s buckets up to 10s for latency, and a `route_tokens` counter. I'll open a runtime PR today with the metric rename/label change. Example queries we'll support:
```promql
# effective token rate for /chat route (1m avg)
rate(tokens_emitted_total{route="/chat"}[1m])
# P95 latency (prom histogram to quantile)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(route_latency_ms_bucket{route="/chat"}[5m])) by (le))
```

maria: For TTFT we discussed both a histogram and a summary; summary gives direct quantiles but histograms are more flexible for rollups. Platform preference?

ajay: Keep histogram + histogram_quantile for dashboard queries. Summaries are tricky across aggregation boundaries. We'll standardize on histogram + sum/count metrics.

sam: UI needs metadata contract: label names exactly and example PromQL per panel. Can you add those to the PR/contract doc. Console team will wire up panels once contract is merged.

kevin: Will add a `docs/metrics/route-slo-schema.md` in the runtime repo with exact label set and sample PromQL.

maria: Rollout plan: canary in staging console + telemetry for one high-traffic route for 48h, check P95/Tokens/sec correlation and storage/cost impact. If ok, expand. Assign owners?

nina: I'll own the canary monitoring and cost checks. Sam will own console panel wiring; Ajay will own ingest/output contract; Kevin will own runtime instrumentation.

telemetry-bot: metric schema draft uploaded to https://links.redwood/internal/metrics/route-slo-schema (proposal-v1).

maria: Perfect. Please comment on the PR with any constraints. If anyone expects a different retention/downsample cadence call it out here. Otherwise we'll merge the contract on Monday and start the canary next week. :rocket:
